nehemiah.6.p1.b1.text: When Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had rebuilt the wall and not a gap was left … Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message … But they were planning to harm me.

nehemiah.6.p1.b2.text: “Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono.”

nehemiah.6.p1.b3.text: “I am doing a great work and cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to go down to you?”

nehemiah.6.p1.b4.text: Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave the same reply.

nehemiah.6.p2.b1.text: The fifth time, Sanballat sent me this same message by his young servant, who had in his hand an unsealed letter

nehemiah.6.p2.b2.text: that read: “It is reported among the nations … you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and this is why you are building the wall. According to these reports, you are to become their king … Soon these rumors will reach the ears of the king. So come, let us confer together.”

nehemiah.6.p2.b3.text: “There is nothing to these rumors you are spreading; you are inventing them in your own mind.”

nehemiah.6.p2.b4.text: But now, my God, strengthen my hands.

nehemiah.6.p3.b1.text: Later, I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was confined to his house.

nehemiah.6.p3.b2.text: “Let us meet at the house of God inside the temple. Let us shut the temple doors because they are coming to kill you— by night they are coming to kill you!”

nehemiah.6.p3.b3.text: “Should a man like me run away? Should one like me go into the temple to save his own life? I will not go!”

nehemiah.6.p4.b1.text: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had uttered this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

nehemiah.6.p4.b2.text: He had been hired to intimidate me so that I would sin by doing as he suggested, so they could give me a bad name in order to discredit me.

nehemiah.6.p4.b3.text: O my God, remember Tobiah and Sanballat for what they have done, and also Noadiah the prophetess and the other prophets who tried to intimidate me.

nehemiah.6.p5.b1.text: So the wall was completed in fifty-two days, on the twenty-fifth of Elul.

nehemiah.6.p5.b2.text: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and disheartened, for they realized that this task had been accomplished by our God.

nehemiah.6.p6.b1.text: Also in those days, the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came back to them.

nehemiah.6.p6.b2.text: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him

nehemiah.6.p6.b3.text: since he was a son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.

nehemiah.6.p6.b4.text: Moreover, these nobles kept reporting to me Tobiah’s good deeds, and they relayed my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.
